Question
Use the source finite independent listing model: A,Y finite, q:A×Y→R cell weights, f:Y→Y, w(s) the product of all |A|² cell weights, C(s) the number of rows equal to the f-twisted diagonal. Define T_k=Σ_{C(s)≥k}w(s) and B_k=Σ_s binom(C(s),k)w(s). If all q(a,y)≥0, then T_k≤B_k for every natural k.
